definitions.label: Theme
definitions.description: Use Phoenix in light, dark, or system-matched mode.

definitions.label: Motion
definitions.description: Controls interface and agent activity animation intensity.

definitions.label: Interface scale
definitions.description: Scales the full desktop interface.

definitions.label: Interface font
definitions.description: Phoenix uses Apfel Grotezk throughout the interface.

definitions.label: Background
definitions.description: Selects the subtle Phoenix background treatment.

definitions.label: Coworker fire
definitions.description: Every coworker uses the same fire, tinted with their color.

definitions.label: Conversation fire
definitions.description: Washes the conversation with the same ember field as the company rail.

definitions.label: Fire motion
definitions.description: Idle flicker on coworker fire. Transform-only so it stays on the compositor.

definitions.label: Type size
definitions.description: Scales settings and conversation type without zooming the window.

definitions.label: Prompt rail
definitions.description: How loud the left prompt markers are.

definitions.label: Composer focus
definitions.description: Warm ember ring when the composer is focused.

definitions.label: Reduce transparency
definitions.description: Uses opaque surfaces and disables backdrop blur.

definitions.label: Film grain
definitions.description: Adds a very subtle surface texture. Off by default: the overlay can paint a black tile on WebKitGTK.

definitions.label: Conversation detail
definitions.description: Compact keeps the thread scannable and folds code out of the way. Detailed shows the agent's edits inline as syntax-highlighted code.

definitions.label: Density
definitions.description: How tight the company rail, settings rows, and composer chrome sit.

definitions.label: Corners
definitions.description: Rounded or sharp edges on cards, the composer, and menus.

definitions.label: Sidebar fire
definitions.description: Warm wash behind the company rail.

definitions.label: Contrast
definitions.description: Ink strength against the paper.

definitions.label: Conversation width
definitions.description: How wide the thread sits in the stage.

definitions.label: Accent
definitions.description: The ember color used for fire, checks, and focus.

definitions.label: Sidebar width
definitions.description: Default expanded width; the sidebar remains directly resizable.

definitions.label: Visible prompt markers
definitions.description: How many recent user prompts appear in conversation navigation at once.

definitions.label: Recent turns on open
definitions.description: Render this many recent user turns immediately. Older turns stay complete and load smoothly when you scroll upward.

definitions.label: Default access
definitions.description: Default access for new messages; per-message changes remain sticky per agent.

definitions.label: Show context usage
definitions.description: Shows live model context usage beside the context-window slider.

definitions.label: Show reasoning
definitions.description: Shows model reasoning when the provider exposes it.

definitions.label: Send shortcut
definitions.description: Keyboard shortcut used to send a message.

definitions.label: Agent collaboration
definitions.description: Allows coworkers to delegate and talk to one another.

definitions.label: Volume workers
definitions.description: Enables temporary workers for independent batch items. Workers inherit the caller's permission mode and receive isolated terminal, desktop, and browser contexts; they clean themselves up when done or cancelled.

definitions.label: Default worker concurrency
definitions.description: Default parallelism when a batch does not choose its own. An explicit batch can use all of its independent items; Phoenix imposes no fixed worker-count ceiling.

definitions.label: Approve outside-group calls
definitions.description: Ask once before a group calls a coworker outside the group.

definitions.label: Read group transcript
definitions.description: Pinged coworkers receive the relevant group transcript by default.

definitions.label: Agent model policy
definitions.description: Whether coworkers inherit the company model or use individual assignments.

definitions.label: Automatic fallbacks
definitions.description: Try connected accounts with the selected model first, then explicitly configured provider backups.

definitions.label: Adaptive action review
definitions.description: Reviews every tool at the shared runtime boundary. Shadow records anomalies without blocking; Enforce blocks only high-confidence dangerous actions. Existing exact-action approvals remain authoritative.

definitions.label: Workspace shell isolation
definitions.description: Runs Workspace-mode shell commands in an OS sandbox that hides user homes, mounts only the project and private build caches writable, and separates process, IPC, and host identity namespaces. Full Access intentionally runs outside this boundary.

definitions.label: Cookie import approval
definitions.description: Automatically copies portable site sessions from the active browser. Device-bound sessions are never copied.

definitions.label: Account creation approval
definitions.description: Lets agents create free website accounts automatically. Paid plans always require fresh approval.

definitions.label: External sends
definitions.description: Requires approval before sending email, messages, or publishing externally.

definitions.label: External deletions
definitions.description: Controls approval before deleting, removing, revoking, or trashing data in connected services.

definitions.label: Purchases and paid plans
definitions.description: Monetary actions require explicit approval.

definitions.label: Browser tools
definitions.description: Allows coworkers to use their private managed browser profiles.

definitions.label: Suspend idle browsers
definitions.description: Persistent coworker browsers stay open until the gateway stops. Set a nonzero value only to opt into idle suspension.

definitions.label: Managed browser profile source
definitions.description: Chooses Phoenix's durable private profile or an existing Chromium profile source.

definitions.label: Cookie import source
definitions.description: Selects the installed browser used for portable sessions. Automatic follows the browser used most recently.

definitions.label: Headless managed browser
definitions.description: Runs background coworker browsers without a separate operating-system window.

definitions.label: Browser attach port
definitions.description: CDP port used only when attaching to a compatible running Chromium browser.

definitions.label: Custom Chromium binary
definitions.description: Optional absolute path to a compatible browser binary; empty uses autodetection.

definitions.label: Automatic CAPTCHA handling
definitions.description: Lets the managed stealth browser attempt supported challenges.

definitions.label: Agent-created accounts
definitions.description: Enables the create-account path when policy permits it.

definitions.label: Automatic 2FA handoff
definitions.description: Lets an agent request a verification code from the relevant coworker.

definitions.label: Long-term memory
definitions.description: Keeps Phoenix and coworkers grounded in durable memory.

definitions.label: Learn from group decisions
definitions.description: Allows the librarian to retain durable decisions from group transcripts.

definitions.label: Saved workflows
definitions.description: Allows coworkers to match and run taught workflows.

definitions.label: Run trusted workflows automatically
definitions.description: Runs healthy trusted routines without re-teaching each step.

definitions.label: Share new workflows
definitions.description: New taught workflows default to company scope instead of the current coworker.

definitions.label: Quarantine failing workflows
definitions.description: Marks repeatedly failing routines obsolete and asks what to do next.

definitions.label: Scheduled work
definitions.description: Allows coworkers to create and run recurring or delayed work.

definitions.label: Notifications
definitions.description: Enables Phoenix attention and completion notifications.

definitions.label: System notifications
definitions.description: Uses the operating system notification service when supported.

definitions.label: Attention requests
definitions.description: Notifies when a coworker needs an answer, approval, login, or other input.

definitions.label: Finished work
definitions.description: Notifies when the coworker you are talking to finishes a turn.

definitions.label: Coworker updates
definitions.description: Notifies when a delegated coworker finishes or needs attention.

definitions.label: Notification sound
definitions.description: Plays a subtle sound when enabled events occur.

definitions.label: Sidebar badges
definitions.description: Shows unread and attention badges on coworkers and groups.

definitions.label: Voice input
definitions.description: Enables dictation and voice controls in the composer.

definitions.label: Spoken replies
definitions.description: Allows the current coworker to read replies aloud.

definitions.label: Vault auto-lock
definitions.description: Locks decrypted credential access after inactivity; zero disables auto-lock.

definitions.label: Password before reveal
definitions.description: Requires the master password before revealing stored credentials.

definitions.label: Prompt customization
definitions.description: Allows user-owned prompt overlays in .phoenix/prompts.

definitions.label: Detailed tool receipts
definitions.description: Keeps expandable exact tool calls and bounded outputs in the activity journal.

definitions.label: Reindex after coding tasks
definitions.description: Refreshes the codebase index once after a successful coding task.

definitions.label: 7-day input planning budget
definitions.description: Local provider-input budget in millions of tokens. This bounds Phoenix replay; it is not a vendor quota percentage because subscription units are dynamic and unpublished.

definitions.label: Usage warning
definitions.description: Warns when Phoenix's local seven-day input estimate reaches this share of the planning budget.

definitions.label: Enforce 7-day hard stop
definitions.description: Stops new provider rounds after the local planning budget is reached. Off by default because provider subscriptions do not publish a stable token-to-quota conversion.

destinations.label: Coworkers
destinations.description: Create, configure, pin, archive, restore, and permanently delete coworkers.

destinations.label: Groups
destinations.description: Create groups, choose members, and configure group collaboration.

destinations.label: Models
destinations.description: Choose models, reasoning, context limits, and per-coworker lanes.

destinations.label: Providers & fallbacks
destinations.description: Manage provider accounts, fallback order, and compaction policy without exposing credentials.

destinations.label: Credentials
destinations.description: Unlock the encrypted vault, manage scoped website credentials, and reveal only with the master password.

destinations.label: Browser profiles
destinations.description: Manage the company account email, private coworker browsers, cookies, imports, website sessions, and saved accounts.

destinations.label: Prompts
destinations.description: Inspect and edit Phoenix and coworker prompt overlays separately from generated core prompts.

destinations.label: Routines & taught workflows
destinations.description: Review, share, correct, reroute, archive, and retire learned work.

destinations.label: Schedules
destinations.description: Create and manage recurring work, notifications, pause state, and owners.

destinations.label: Notifications
destinations.description: Configure desktop alerts, sounds, badges, and completion or attention events.

destinations.label: Memory
destinations.description: Inspect company and coworker memory health, indexing, retention, and sharing boundaries.

destinations.label: Appearance
destinations.description: Choose light or dark mode, typography, density, motion, background, and sidebar size.

destinations.label: Voice
destinations.description: Choose voice input, spoken replies, devices, and voice behavior.

destinations.label: Data & storage
destinations.description: Inspect local Phoenix data, artifact storage, snapshots, exports, archives, and retention.

destinations.label: Skills
destinations.description: Installed playbooks from skills.sh — the crafts Phoenix follows instead of improvising.

destinations.label: Composio
destinations.description: Consumer key and connected apps Phoenix can act through.

destinations.label: MCP
destinations.description: Local and remote MCP servers the company can call.

destinations.label: Integrations
destinations.description: Manage Composio and local MCP connections, permissions, and routing.

destinations.label: Coworker relationships
destinations.description: Edit durable trust and collaboration patterns between visible coworkers.

destinations.label: Diagnostics
destinations.description: Inspect runtime health, provider status, browser lifecycle, indexes, and logs.

guide.title: Choose what agents may do
guide.description: Use Permissions for sends, logins, accounts, and purchases. Browser & Accounts controls how those approved actions run.

guide.title: Assign models and fallbacks
guide.description: Models & Providers owns company and per-agent model choices, provider accounts, reasoning, and fallback order.

guide.title: Manage learned work
guide.description: Workflows & Routines contains taught browser routines, sharing, trust, and failure quarantine. Schedules contains recurring work.

guide.title: Protect accounts
guide.description: Security configures vault behavior. Credentials are managed through the vault action and never appear in settings data.

guide.title: Tune each coworker
guide.description: Open an agent profile for scoped overrides. Unset values inherit the company setting automatically.

provenance.method: Static balanced Rust catalog extraction, not compiled/runtime acceptance
